output_list.criticism: The 'transfer' function does not check for overflow when transferring tokens, allowing attackers to exploit this vulnerability to increase their token balance.
The 'buy' function does not check for overflow when transferring tokens, allowing attackers to exploit this vulnerability to increase their token balance.
The 'sell' function does not check for overflow when transferring tokens, allowing attackers to exploit this vulnerability to devalue the token.
The 'mintToken' function allows the owner to mint tokens for any address, which can be exploited to create an overflow in the balanceOf mapping.
The 'setPrices' function allows the owner to set the buy and sell prices, which can be exploited to create an overflow in the balanceOf mapping.
